configuration:
name: coolify-proxy
networks:
  coolify:
    external: true
services:
  traefik:
    container_name: coolify-proxy
    image: 'traefik:v3.6'
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - coolify
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '443:443'
    command:
      - '--providers.docker=true'
      - '--certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.email=fixture@example.com'
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - 'traefik.http.middlewares.dash-auth.basicauth.users=admin:$$apr1$$fixture$$notreal'
